titulo: Two seconds of asking before moving it
caption:
Two seconds of asking before moving it

"Can I move this?" "Go ahead!" Two seconds of asking before touching someone else's plant.

Asking first turns a small move into a shared decision, and it only costs one sentence.

For whoever asks before moving someone else's things.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a leafy potted plant in the middle. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left turns toward a royal blue block figure on the right. A bubble says can I move this? The blue one opens its eyes wide and a bubble says go ahead! The plant slides to the left. The black one answers thanks! and both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me asking before I move your things.
